title: Companies are grappling with whether and how to curb employee wagers on prediction markets that may use confidential info, as platforms tighten their own rules (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Companies are grappling with whether and how to curb employee wagers on prediction markets that may use confidential info, as platforms tighten their own rules — Companies are grappling with whether and how to rein in employee wagers that could use confidential information
